{{Quote|Tell your people to take shelter. If you have warriors, now is the time.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Tion Medon|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Utapaun resistance''' was formed in response to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Master of Port Administration]] [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]] coordinated the resistance efforts, hiding the planet's [[Porax-38 starfighter]]s until the arrival of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Databank" /> Medon's forces allied with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|301|Medon, Tion}}</ref> although Medon and other resistance figures were [[Prisoner/Legends|arrested]] after the battle by the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="Databank" />
